subject: [PATCH bpf-next] bpf, cgroup: Don't lose errors in effective BPF_LSM_CGROUP queries

reviews.author: patchwork-bot+netdevbpf@kernel.org
reviews.summary: The patch was applied to bpf/bpf.git (master) by Alexei Starovoitov, but no substantive discussion has occurred yet.

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue in the BPF LSM cgroup query where errors are lost due to overwriting of the return value. It fixes this by returning -EFAULT immediately when a copy faults, and leaves the return value unchanged otherwise.
